source.title: 自由漂浮空间机器人捕获翻滚目标的力-位-型融合控制方法
source.file: reference_papers/自由漂浮空间机器人捕获翻滚...标的力-位-型融合控制方法_梁斌.pdf

dh.locator: Table 2, PDF 8, printed 965; frame drawing Fig 3 printed 963

reference.locator: Eq 26 printed 964; text printed 966; conclusion printed 968

model.mount_rationale: DH0 z points toward the negative base-z target half-space; Rx(pi) is a declared underslung installation. Identity placement was rejected during static geometry construction, before any trajectory evaluation, because target distance from shoulder exceeds the link reach.
model.com_rule: B_i midpoint of its standard-DH translation, expressed in post-Rz pre-Rx body; zero-translation wrist bodies at joint origin
model.inertia_rule: table diagonal interpreted about COM, principal axes aligned to post-Rz pre-Rx body; not asserted to be author axes
model.collision_geometry: NOT_VERIFIED; link centerlines are schematic only, no massless graphics claimed as physical envelopes
model.inertia_realizability: positive equivalent ellipsoid radii derived from table mass/inertia; no inertia fitting or scaling
model.external_contacts: disabled; no target rigid body, prescribed target is planning reference only

target.spin_model: constant principal-axis rotation; satisfies free Euler motion for an unspecified axisymmetric inertia, no dynamic target or contact claim

reference.position: quintic blend in inertial world coordinates
reference.orientation: shortest SO3 geodesic with same quintic scalar; zero first and second endpoint derivatives
reference.shape: continuous initial-to-terminal scalar with terminal in [-pi,pi]; no shortest-wrap substitution of the prescribed terminal scalar
reference.nullspace_interpretation: Eq 29-31 shape demand is residual desired shape rate minus Jpsi times primary velocity; literal printed sum tested separately
reference.shape_reference_axis: positive first joint axis in DH0, V=[0,0,1]

optimization.time_bounds_rationale: bounded 50-100 degree target rotation at published 5 deg/s, surrounding author point, fixed before any rollout; a declared 20-second rendezvous deadline
optimization.delta_o: peak norm of world base angular velocity over complete approach
optimization.alignment: acos of signed dot product between prescribed grasp velocity and initial-system-COM to final grasp vector; endpoint robot reference velocity zero
optimization.feasibility_order: feasible candidates precede every infeasible candidate; infeasible rank uses fixed normalized violation sum, then objective
optimization.planning_method: source_nullspace; kinematic integration only, not true dynamics

controller.torque_servo: floating-base Schur-complement computed torque with common joint reference integration

gates.source: S01 engineering assumptions, independent of Flexiv gates
gates.early_stop: nonfinite; matrix/shape singularity; commanded or actual joint bound breach; torque clipping; position error >0.10m; rotation error >0.5rad

numerical_tests.rationale: centered double-precision finite differences at h=1e-6, with h/2 and 2h consistency checks; dimensioned quantities tested separately

pdf_visual_review.method: pdftoppm page images and text independently inspected; tables and formulas checked against images
